desc: Implement input parsing for T test cases, each with N, K, and arrays X, Y, Z.
Implement binary search on the answer M over the range [0, 2*10^9+1], collecting the maximum feasible M.

Implement the feasibility check: define per-component high sets, check early-return condition, build flow network with source/high/low/sink nodes, generate edges efficiently to avoid O(N^2), and run Dinic's max-flow to determine if K pairs are possible.
Integrate the feasibility check into the binary search loop, replacing the placeholder.
Test the implementation on the sample inputs to ensure it produces the correct outputs (12, 209, 333).
Optimize edge generation to ensure O(N log N + K^2) per feasibility check, acceptable for sum N <= 1e5 and T <= 1000.
Handle edge cases: N=2K exactly, all values zero, large values up to 1e9.
